e.title: 一条「可审计」的情报流水线：**原始抽取尝试与胜出者一起留存**、模型用量单独入库、方法健康与本地看板可见——而本地优先（local-first）是它的标题词
e.title_en: An auditable intelligence pipeline that keeps the raw extraction attempts alongside the winner, persists model usage separately and exposes method health and a local dashboard — with local-first being the word in its own title
e.title_hk: 一條「可審計」的情報流水線：**原始抽取嘗試與勝出者一起留存**、模型用量單獨入庫、方法健康與本地看板可見——而本地優先（local-first）是它的標題詞
e.summary: 一条面向**伦敦 Lloyd’s 市场**的**新闻发现 ＋ 抽取 ＋ AI 打分 ＋ HTML／邮件摘要**流水线：把跨保险公司、经纪、监管与财经媒体的更新**每日跑成一份可重复的摘要**；**其最值得记的一处是它把「依据」落在**留存**上而不是文档上**——**逐字「一份**透明、可审计**的流水线，**原始数据与处理后的数据都留存以备复核**」**，**而这一句在架构里是**看得见**的**：**其 mermaid 架构图把存储分成两端，其中 Mongo 一端的节点逐字为**「discovery snapshots／fetch cache／**raw attempts winners**／AI cache」**，**即**原始抽取尝试与**胜出者**并列留存**；**Postgres 一端则逐字为**「attempts articles／**LLM usage** digests」**，**即**模型用量本身也是一张表****；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 它有一个**可观察性**条目**（**逐字「run metrics、**method health**、以及一个**本地看板**」**），**而**方法健康**意味着**每种抽取方法的成功率被单独跟踪****；**② 它在维护说明里逐条写明**不该做什么****（**逐字「Rotate secrets: update `.env` values（**never commit**）」**）；**③ 它的排错一节有一条**承认对方在拦****（**逐字「高的 403／429 率：更新 HTTP 抓取器的 user-agent 并降低并发；**有些站点会拦阻激进的抓取**」**）
e.summary_hk: 一條面向**倫敦 Lloyd’s 市場**的**新聞發現 ＋ 抽取 ＋ AI 打分 ＋ HTML／郵件摘要**流水線：把跨保險公司、經紀、監管與財經媒體的更新**每日跑成一份可重複的摘要**；**其最值得記的一處是它把「依據」落在**留存**上而不是文檔上**——**逐字「一份**透明、可審計**的流水線，**原始數據與處理後的數據都留存以備複核**」**，**而這一句在架構裡是**看得見**的**：**其 mermaid 架構圖把存儲分成兩端，其中 Mongo 一端的節點逐字為**「discovery snapshots／fetch cache／**raw attempts winners**／AI cache」**，**即**原始抽取嘗試與**勝出者**並列留存**；**Postgres 一端則逐字為**「attempts articles／**LLM usage** digests」**，**即**模型用量本身也是一張表****；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 它有一個**可觀察性**條目**（**逐字「run metrics、**method health**、以及一個**本地看板**」**），**而**方法健康**意味著**每種抽取方法的成功率被單獨跟蹤****；**② 它在維護說明裡逐條寫明**不該做什麼****（**逐字「Rotate secrets: update `.env` values（**never commit**）」**）；**③ 它的排錯一節有一條**承認對方在攔****（**逐字「高的 403／429 率：更新 HTTP 抓取器的 user-agent 並降低並發；**有些站點會攔阻激進的抓取**」**）
e.summary_en: A news discovery, extraction, AI scoring and HTML-and-email digest pipeline for the London Lloyd’s market, producing a repeatable daily digest of updates across insurers, brokers, regulators and the financial press; **its most notable feature is that it grounds its claims in retention rather than in documentation** — verbatim, **a transparent, auditable pipeline with raw and processed data stored for review**, **and that sentence is visible in the architecture**: its diagram splits storage in two, with one side listing discovery snapshots, a fetch cache, **raw attempts and winners**, and an AI cache, so **the raw extraction attempts are retained alongside the winning one**, while the other side lists attempts and articles alongside **LLM usage**, so model consumption is its own table; **three further points follow the same discipline**: **first, it has an observability entry** naming run metrics, **method health** and a **local dashboard**, where method health means **each extraction method’s success rate is tracked separately**; **second, its maintenance notes state what not to do**, verbatim that rotating secrets means updating environment values and **never committing them**; **and third, its troubleshooting section concedes that the other side blocks**, warning that high 403 and 429 rates mean updating the fetcher user agent and reducing concurrency because **some sites block aggressive fetches**
e.body:
**lloyds-news-digest**（仓库 `poovannanrajendran/lloyds-market-news-digest`）**是一条面向伦敦 Lloyd’s 市场的新闻发现 ＋ 抽取 ＋ AI 打分 ＋ HTML／邮件摘要流水线**：**把跨保险公司、经纪、监管与财经媒体的更新每日跑成一份可重复的摘要**。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 **437,222 KB**、创建 2026-01-25、最后推送 2026-09-10、topics 为 `ai`／`commercial-specialty-insurance`／`extractions`／`insurance`／`llm`／`london-insurance`／`london-lloyds-market`／`news`／`news-digest`／`relevance-check`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送**均在解冻窗口之外与之内**——**⚠️ 创建 2026-01-25 早于窗口，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 4,882 字节**；**仓库实测共 **2,467 个文件、34 个目录**（**⚠️ 本次经 GitHub API 的 tree 接口实测，未下载 tarball——**因其 437 MB 体量下载超时**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把依据放在你能看见的地方——以及当条件本身不在那里时」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把依据落在**留存**上、而不是落在文档上的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「可审计」被写成一句产品承诺，而在架构图里变成**具体的存储节点****——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处**：**其「What It Serves」一节逐字为**：**「- A **repeatable daily digest** of Lloyd’s market news. - **A transparent, auditable pipeline with raw and processed data stored for review.** - **An OpenAI-first AI workflow with model-level cost controls.**」**；**而其 mermaid 架构图把存储分成两端，节点逐字为**：**「B --> J["**Mongo discovery snapshots**"]；D --> J["**Mongo fetch cache**"]；E --> J["**Mongo raw attempts winners**"]；F --> J["**Mongo AI cache**"]；E --> I["**Postgres attempts articles**"]；F --> I["**Postgres LLM usage digests**"]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「原始抽取尝试与胜出者」**（**`raw attempts winners`**）**并列留存**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条最实在的一处**：**一份摘要里的每个字段都可能来自多种抽取方法的竞争，**而这里**落败的尝试与胜出的那次都被留下****（**⭐ 与第 340 轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「出典逐条随数据同行」、第 342 轮 [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 的「夹具含中间值」同族，**但这里是**流水线运行时**的版本**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「LLM usage」单独入库**（**`Postgres LLM usage digests`**）**——**⭐ 即**模型用量**不是日志，而是一张可查的表**（**⭐ 与其「**model-level cost controls**」一句相配**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **存储**分两端**（**Mongo 存发现快照、抓取缓存、原始尝试、AI 缓存；Postgres 存尝试与文章、LLM 用量与摘要**）**——**⭐ 即**「原始层」与「成品层」被分开**；**④ **架构图本身**被提交在仓库里**（**mermaid 源码**）**——**⭐ 即**流程图**与其代码同处一仓、可随代码更新**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **可观察性被列为一项功能，而其中「方法健康」意味着一件事被单独跟踪**——**逐字为**：**「- **Observability**: **run metrics, method health, and a local dashboard**.」**；**并另有逐字为** **「- **Multi-method extraction with audit logging and method learning.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「方法健康」**（**method health**）**——**⭐ 本词条指出：**这意味着**每种抽取方法的成功率被单独跟踪**，**而**不是只看整体产出**（**⭐ 即**哪一条抽取路径在退化**是可以被看见的**）；**② ⭐⭐ **看板是**本地**的**（**`local dashboard`**）**——**⭐ 与其标题中的 local-first（本地优先）一致**；**③ ⭐⭐ **抽取是**多方法**的且带**审计日志**与**方法学习****（**⭐ 即**方法选择本身是一个被记录、被改进的对象**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **维护说明逐条写明**不该做什么**，其中一条是「绝不提交」**——**逐字为**：**「- **Rotate secrets**: update `.env` values（**never commit**）. - **Database hygiene**: run `scripts/db_init_postgres.sh` and `scripts/db_init_mongo.js` when schema/index changes occur. - **Cache control**: disable cache via `LLOYDS_DIGEST__CACHE__ENABLED=false` for debugging. - **Model changes**: update prompt files in `src/lloyds_digest/ai/prompts/` and **track changes in `CHANGELOG.md`**. - **Health checks**: review run metrics and method health section in the digest or `output/dashboard/index.html`.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **「绝不提交」是一条**禁令而不是建议****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「模型变更要更新提示词文件并**在 `CHANGELOG.md` 里跟踪****」**——**⭐ 即**提示词的改动被要求进变更日志**（**⭐ 本词条认为这一点很实在：**模型的提示词**在多数项目里是没有版本记录的**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **健康检查落到一个**具体文件路径**（**`output/dashboard/index.html`**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **排错一节承认对方在拦，并给出应对**——**逐字为**：**「- **No candidates discovered**: check `sources.csv` URLs and page type（`rss` vs `listing`）… - **Empty digest**: confirm extraction succeeded; **inspect Mongo `attempts_raw` and Postgres `attempts` for failures**. - **High 403/429 rates**: **update user-agent in the HTTP fetcher and reduce concurrency; some sites block aggressive fetches**. - **Mongo cache conflicts**: ensure cache key uses canonical URL + fetcher name…」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「有些站点会拦阻激进的抓取」**——**⭐ 即**它**承认自己被拦**，**而**不是把 403／429 当成待修的 bug**（**⭐ 与第 344 轮同批 [[insurek-swiss-deductible]] 的「为什么不抓取官方计算器」形成对照：**一个选择不抓，一个被抓时降速****）；**② ⭐⭐ **排错步骤指向**具体的存储集合与表**（**Mongo `attempts_raw`、Postgres `attempts`**）**——**⭐ 即**「原始尝试」是可被直接查看的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **缓存键被要求用**规范 URL ＋ 抓取器名**——**⭐ 即**同一条链接由不同抓取器取得时被视为不同缓存条目**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其功能清单逐条具体，且含「忽略缓存」等可操作性开关**——**逐字为**：**「- Source discovery（**RSS + listing pages**）with **candidate de-duplication**. - Robust HTTP fetching with **retry and cache**. - Multi-method extraction with **audit logging and method learning**. - **AI relevance/classification/summarisation with cache and usage tracking**. - HTML digest rendering（**internal + public**）with **optional SMTP delivery**. - Observability: run metrics, method health, and a local dashboard. - **Publishing and social artifacts（GitHub Pages + LinkedIn assets）**.」**；**命令级细节逐字含** **「`python -m lloyds_digest run --now`」**、**「`--max-candidates 50`」**、**「`--max-sources 20`」**、**「`--force-refresh`」**、**以及一个**跨模型对比渲染**脚本（**`scripts/render_digest_llm_compare.py`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「相关性／分类／摘要」三件事由 AI 做，**且带缓存与用量跟踪****——**⭐ 即**AI 的每一次调用**都被记账**；**② ⭐⭐ **内部版与公开版**两种摘要**（**`internal + public`**）**——**⭐ 即**同一份产出有**两个受众与两套措辞****；**③ ⭐⭐ **有一个**跨模型对比**的渲染脚本**（**⭐ 即**换模型的效果是**可以被并排看的****）。**⑥ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **运行环境写明**（**需 Postgres、Mongo、SMTP 与 OpenAI 设置；conda 环境名为 `314`**）**；**② **调度写明**（**launchd（macOS）或 cron（Linux）**，**并用 `scripts/run_daily.sh`**）**；**③ **告警写明**（**Slack／Discord ＋ 一个 n8n 工作流监视器**）**；**④ **实测根目录**文件逐项含** **`.coderabbit.yaml`**（**一个 AI 代码审查工具的配置**）、**`CODEBASE_GUIDE.md`**、**`DAY2_OPS_RUNBOOK.md`**、**`CHANGELOG.md`**、**`boilerplate.yaml`**、**`config.yaml`**、**`.env.example`**、**`phases.md`**（**README 逐字称其为「the original phase-by-phase implementation plan」**）**；**⑤ **实测目录规模**为 **`docs/` 384 个文件、`output/` 1,967 个文件、`migrations/` 7 个文件、`n8n/` 1 个文件****——**⭐ 即**仓库的绝大部分是**已提交的产出与文档**，**而不是源码**（**⭐ 这也解释了其 437 MB 的体量**）。**⑦ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[daily-news-report]]、[[insuranceasia-news]]、[[reinsurance-news]]、[[rsshub]]、[[insurance-content-growth]]、[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[quotelens-provenance]]、[[friction-ledger-claimwatch]]、[[medical-opinion-extractor]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NONE****——**实测该仓库**无任何许可文件**，**README 亦无许可章节**；**⚠️ 故**本词条**不主张**其代码、配置、提示词或已提交的产出可在任何条件下使用**，**使用或再分发前应先向作者确认授权**；**⭐ 特别提示**：**其 `output/` 下有 **1,967 个已提交的产出文件**，**其中可能包含从第三方新闻来源抽取的文本**——**⚠️ 本词条**未读其中任何一份**，**故**不转述**其内容，**亦**不主张**其再分发条件已被澄清**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该流水线的任何一步****——**未克隆（**其 437 MB 体量使 tarball 下载超时**）、未建 conda 环境、未装依赖、未建 Postgres 或 Mongo、未运行 `python -m lloyds_digest run`、未运行任何 `scripts/` 下脚本、未打开其线上站点**；**故**本词条**不主张**其每日摘要、抽取成功率、方法健康、成本控制或任何产出**已被复现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与其**经 tree 接口实测的目录结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、提示词、配置文件或已提交产出的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**「原始尝试与胜出者」是否确实按架构图存入 Mongo**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**——**⭐ 它是一个**关于留存的断言**，**而本词条只有 README 与架构图的依据**）；**「LLM 用量」是否确实单独成表**；**方法健康是否确实按方法分别统计**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其抓取是否遵守任何来源站点的条款或 `robots.txt`**（**⭐ 其排错一节已承认会被 403／429 拦阻**；**⚠️ 本词条**未访问其 `sources.csv`**——**⚠️ 事实上**该文件**本词条**未在 tree 的顶层清单中确认其存在**，**而 README 的维护说明把它列为**来源注册表****；**⭐ 本词条据此**不主张**其来源清单已被核实**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实** `output/` 下已提交的产出是否含任何受版权保护的第三方内容**（**⚠️ 这是一个新闻摘要类项目**须自行确认的问题**；**本词条**未读任何产出文件、未做任何比对**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其「本地优先」的具体含义**（**⭐ 该词出现在**仓库描述**里**，**而 README 中对应的是**本地看板**与**本机运行**两处**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**它等同于「数据不出本机」**——**因为其运行依赖 Postgres、Mongo 与 OpenAI**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其摘要可用于任何投资、承保或合规判断**（**⭐ 其自述为**AI 打分与摘要**，**且**其相关性判断是**一个具名步骤**（`relevance-check`）而非保证**）。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者身份、资历或该项目是否被任何机构使用**。**⑨ ⭐ **★1、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其 README **仅 4,882 字节**，**而仓库有 **2,467 个文件**、一份排错清单、一份维护清单、一份运维 runbook、一份阶段计划、一份跨模型对比脚本与 **1,967 份已提交产出****——**⭐ 即**代码与文档、产出三者密度都高而关注度极低**的一种形态**；**应如实写出，不用星数代替判断****。**⑩ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-01-25）****——**⭐ 如实记录该日期，**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）****。**⑪ ⚠️ **README 为**英文****。**⑫ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/poovannanrajendran/lloyds-market-news-digest` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 NONE、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间、topics 与 homepage）；README 4,882 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其引用其 What It Serves、Core Features、架构图、维护说明与排错一节**）；**其文件树经 `https://api.github.com/repos/…/git/trees/main?recursive=1` 实测读取（**返回 2,467 个文件、34 个目录，`truncated` 为 false**）**——**⚠️ 本次**未下载 tarball**（**437 MB 使其超时，**已在标注中写明**）；**未克隆、未运行任何命令、未读任何源码或产出内容、未访问其线上站点、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「可審計」被寫成一句產品承諾，而在架構圖裡變成**具體的存儲節點****：**其「What It Serves」一節逐字為** **「- A **repeatable daily digest** of Lloyd’s market news. - **A transparent, auditable pipeline with raw and processed data stored for review.** - **An OpenAI-first AI workflow with model-level cost controls.**」**；**而其 mermaid 架構圖把存儲分成兩端，節點逐字為** **「B --> J["**Mongo discovery snapshots**"]；D --> J["**Mongo fetch cache**"]；E --> J["**Mongo raw attempts winners**"]；F --> J["**Mongo AI cache**"]；E --> I["**Postgres attempts articles**"]；F --> I["**Postgres LLM usage digests**"]」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「原始抽取嘗試與勝出者」（`raw attempts winners`）並列留存**——**⭐ 這是本條最實在的一處：一份摘要裡的每個字段都可能來自多種抽取方法的競爭，而這裡落敗的嘗試與勝出的那次都被留下**（與第 340 輪 insurance-portfolio-performance 的「出典逐條隨數據同行」、第 342 輪 ratecraft 的「夾具含中間值」同族，但這裡是流水線運行時的版本）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「LLM usage」單獨入庫**（`Postgres LLM usage digests`，即模型用量不是日誌而是一張可查的表，與其「model-level cost controls」相配）；**③ ⭐⭐ 存儲分兩端**（Mongo 存發現快照、抓取緩存、原始嘗試、AI 緩存；Postgres 存嘗試與文章、LLM 用量與摘要，即「原始層」與「成品層」被分開）；**④ 架構圖本身被提交在倉庫裡**（mermaid 源碼，即流程圖與其代碼同處一倉、可隨代碼更新）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **可觀察性被列為一項功能，而其中「方法健康」意味著一件事被單獨跟蹤**：**「- **Observability**: **run metrics, method health, and a local dashboard**.」** 與 **「- **Multi-method extraction with audit logging and method learning.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「方法健康」（method health）意味著每種抽取方法的成功率被單獨跟蹤**（而不是只看整體產出，即哪一條抽取路徑在退化是可以被看見的）；**② ⭐⭐ 看板是**本地**的（local dashboard，與其標題中的 local-first 一致）；**③ ⭐⭐ 抽取是多方法的且帶審計日誌與方法學習**（方法選擇本身是一個被記錄、被改進的對象）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **維護說明逐條寫明不該做什麼，其中一條是「絕不提交」**：**「- **Rotate secrets**: update `.env` values（**never commit**）. - **Health checks**: review run metrics and method health section in the digest or `output/dashboard/index.html`.」**⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐「絕不提交」是一條**禁令而不是建議****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「模型變更要更新提示詞文件並在 CHANGELOG.md 裡跟蹤」**（提示詞的改動被要求進變更日誌——**這一點很實在：模型的提示詞在多數項目裡是沒有版本記錄的**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 健康檢查落到一個具體文件路徑**（`output/dashboard/index.html`）；**④ ⭐⭐ **排錯一節承認對方在攔並給出應對**：**「- **Empty digest**: confirm extraction succeeded; **inspect Mongo `attempts_raw` and Postgres `attempts` for failures**. - **lloyds-news-digest** (repository `poovannanrajendran/lloyds-market-news-digest`) **is a news discovery, extraction, AI scoring and HTML-and-email digest pipeline for the London Lloyd’s market**, **producing a repeatable daily digest of updates across insurers, brokers, regulators and the financial press**. **Measured ★1, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), primary language HTML, a **437,222 KB** repository, created 2026-01-25, last pushed 2026-09-10, topics `ai`, `commercial-specialty-insurance`, `extractions`, `insurance`, `llm`, `london-insurance`, `london-lloyds-market`, `news`, `news-digest` and `relevance-check`** (all GitHub API measurements; ⚠️ **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 4,882 bytes**; **the repository measures 2,467 files and 34 directories**, ⚠️ **read this time through the GitHub trees endpoint rather than a tarball, since its 437 MB size made the download time out**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the basis should be placed where you can see it, and that the interesting case is when the terms themselves are not there**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it grounds its basis in retention rather than in documentation**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Auditability is a product promise in prose and becomes concrete storage nodes in the architecture diagram** — **the most notable point in this entry**: **its section on what it serves reads verbatim as a repeatable daily digest of market news, a transparent and auditable pipeline with raw and processed data stored for review, and an OpenAI-first AI workflow with model-level cost controls**; **and its diagram splits storage in two, with nodes reading verbatim as a discovery snapshots store, a fetch cache, **raw attempts and winners**, and an AI cache on one side, and attempts, articles, and **LLM usage** and digests on the other** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **raw extraction attempts are retained alongside the winning one, which this entry takes as the most substantive point here: each field in a digest may come from a competition between extraction methods, and here the losing attempts and the winning one are both kept — the same family as round 340’s provenance travelling with each record and round 342’s fixtures carrying their intermediates, but at pipeline runtime rather than in a fixture**; ⭐⭐⭐ **LLM usage is persisted as its own table rather than as a log, matching the stated model-level cost controls**; ⭐⭐ **storage is split in two, one side holding discovery snapshots, the fetch cache, raw attempts and the AI cache and the other holding attempts and articles alongside usage and digests, so the raw layer and the finished layer are kept apart**; **and the diagram itself is committed as Markdown source, so the flow lives beside the code and can be updated with it**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Observability is listed as a feature, and method health inside it means one thing is tracked separately** — verbatim, observability comprises **run metrics, method health and a local dashboard**, alongside an item reading verbatim as **multi-method extraction with audit logging and method learning** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **method health means each extraction method’s success rate is tracked on its own rather than only the overall output, so a degrading extraction path can be seen**; ⭐⭐ **the dashboard is local, consistent with local-first in the repository description**; **and ⭐⭐ extraction is multi-method with audit logging and method learning, so the choice of method is itself something recorded and improved**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its maintenance notes state what not to do, one item being never to commit certain values** — verbatim, rotating secrets means updating environment values and **never committing them**; model changes mean updating prompt files and **tracking the change in a changelog**; cache can be disabled by an environment variable for debugging; and health checks mean reviewing run metrics and the method health section in the digest or the dashboard file ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **"never commit" is a prohibition rather than advice**; ⭐⭐⭐ **prompt changes are required to be tracked in the changelog, which is a substantive point since prompts in most projects carry no version record**; **and ⭐⭐ health checks land on a concrete file path**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its troubleshooting section concedes that the other side blocks and gives a response** — verbatim, an empty digest means confirming extraction succeeded and **inspecting the raw attempts collection and the attempts table for failures**, and **high 403 and 429 rates mean updating the fetcher user agent and reducing concurrency because some sites block aggressive fetches** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **"some sites block aggressive fetches" concedes that it is being blocked rather than treating a 403 or 429 as a bug to fix**, ⭐ **forming a contrast with this round’s policy of declining to scrape an official calculator at all: one chooses not to scrape, the other slows down when blocked**; ⭐⭐ **the troubleshooting steps point at concrete storage collections and tables, so the raw attempts are directly inspectable**; **and ⭐⭐ cache keys must combine the canonical URL with the fetcher name, so the same link fetched by different fetchers counts as different cache entries**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Its feature list is item by item and includes operational switches** — source discovery over RSS and listing pages with candidate de-duplication, robust HTTP fetching with retry and cache, **AI relevance, classification and summarisation with cache and usage tracking**, HTML digest rendering in internal and public variants with optional email delivery, and publishing and social artifacts for GitHub Pages and LinkedIn; **with command-level detail including running a digest on demand and caps on candidates and sources, a force-refresh flag, and a script that renders digests across models for comparison** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **relevance, classification and summarisation are done by AI and carry caching and usage tracking, so every model call is accounted**; ⭐⭐ **there are internal and public variants of the digest, so one output serves two audiences with two sets of wording**; **and ⭐⭐ a cross-model comparison script exists, so the effect of changing models can be viewed side by side**. **⑥ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **the runtime requirements are stated, including Postgres, Mongo, SMTP and model settings under a named conda environment**; **scheduling is stated as launchd or cron with a daily run script**; **alerting is stated as Slack or Discord plus an automation-platform workflow monitor**; **and measured root files include an AI code-review tool’s configuration, a codebase guide, a second-day operations runbook, a changelog, a boilerplate file, a config file, an env example and a phase plan described verbatim as the original phase-by-phase implementation plan**; **measured directory sizes are 384 files under docs, 1,967 under output, 7 migrations and one automation-platform file**, ⭐ **so the bulk of the repository is committed output and documentation rather than source, which also explains its 437 MB size**. **⑦ ⭐ Readable with** [[daily-news-report]], [[insuranceasia-news]], [[reinsurance-news]], [[rsshub]], [[insurance-content-growth]], [[application-fill-provenance]], [[quotelens-provenance]], [[friction-ledger-claimwatch]] and [[medical-opinion-extractor]].

⭐ **in particular, 1,967 committed output files sit under the output directory and may contain text extracted from third-party news sources** — ⚠️ **none of them was read, so their contents are not restated and no claim is made that their redistribution status has been settled**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the pipeline was run** — **nothing was cloned, its 437 MB size having made the tarball download time out; no conda environment was created, no dependency installed, no Postgres or Mongo created, no run command executed, no script under the scripts directory run, and its live site not opened**; **so its daily digest, extraction success rates, method health, cost controls and any output are not claimed to have been reproduced** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and its directory structure as measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, prompt, configuration file or committed output was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: whether raw attempts and winners really land in the database as the diagram shows, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry because it is an assertion about retention supported here only by the README and the diagram;
